name: combo-chart
purpose: Accessible SVG chart combining bars, lines, and areas over shared categories, each series on the primary (start-side) or secondary (end-side) value axis, with grouped or stacked bars, a toggleable legend, keyboard-reachable marks with tooltips, a category tooltip on hover, optional crosshair, optional zoom and pan over categories, a generated summary, and a data table fallback.
whenToUse: Two related measures on different scales (for example revenue as bars and margin as a line on a secondary axis).
Actuals as bars with a target or average as a line.
A few series (up to about 8) over the same categories.
whenNotToUse: One kind of mark only: use Bar Chart or Line Chart.
Numeric or time x values: use Line Chart or Scatter Chart.
Part-to-whole: use Pie Chart or a stacked Bar Chart.
responsive: Width follows the container (ResizeObserver); height is the height option. Category labels thin and truncate with the band width; the value axes reserve the width of their labels. Reflows at 320 CSS px.
rtl: direction rtl mirrors the category axis (first category at the right), puts the primary axis on the right and the secondary axis on the left, reverses bar order within a group, and swaps ArrowLeft/ArrowRight. Legend, tooltip, and table follow the document direction.
theme: Colors from color-chart-1..8 by palette slot; gridlines color-chart-grid; axes color-chart-axis; text color-text / color-text-muted; tooltip color-surface with color-border-strong. Forced colors use CanvasText, Canvas, GrayText, and Highlight.
timezone: Not applicable: numeric and category axes only; no dates are formatted.
security: All text (title, description, labels, values, tooltip, table) is set with textContent; SVG is built with createElementNS. Colors are CSS classes; sizes and the tooltip position are written through the CSSOM (style.setProperty). No innerHTML, no style attributes, no inline handlers: works under style-src without unsafe-inline and require-trusted-types-for.
dataHandling: Renders the data it is given; no persistence, network access, or telemetry. Values are not logged; validation errors name the option, never its value.

budgets.metric: ComboChart.create, 3 series x 200 categories, including the first render
budgets.budget: < 60 ms in headless Chromium (e2e performance test)

performance.testedScale: Measured in tests/e2e/perf-r3.spec.ts with 3 series x 200 categories. One DOM node per bar and per line/area point (no virtual marks); use zoom for long category lists. The data table is built only when opened (toggle mode).

limitations: Each series needs exactly one value per category.
Lines and areas are never stacked; stacking applies to bars per axis.
Secondary axis draws tick labels only (no gridlines); its tick count follows the primary axis unless set.
Axis label widths are estimated (about 0.6 em per character).
unsupported: More than two value axes; logarithmic axes.
Zoom on the value axes; linked zoom across charts.
HTML content in labels or tooltips.
antiPatterns: Two axes for unrelated measures (invites false correlation).
Many bar series plus many lines in one chart.
Hiding the data table (dataTable: none) for data users must read exactly.
